description: This file defines the QhullFacet class, representing a facet in the Qhull computational geometry library. It includes class members, methods for geometric computations, and IO operators related to facets.

classes.name: QhullFacet
classes.description: Represents a facet in the Qhull geometry, providing access to geometric properties, neighboring facets, and IO operations.

methods.name: dimension
methods.description: Returns the dimension of the facet based on the hull's dimension.

methods.name: getCenter
methods.description: Calculates and returns the center point of the facet.

methods.name: hyperplane
methods.description: Returns the hyperplane associated with the facet.

methods.name: distance
methods.description: Calculates the distance from the facet to a point or coordinate.
